instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show everything my account runs on its own (due times, facts it hears, programs it keeps running): what each waits for, whether it is on, its last run, which ones should have run and did not, and a switch to turn each off or on", and give it wakes (the rows wake:list answers: [{tool, id, on, budget, switched_on, mark}]).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-what-runs-on-its-own and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give wakes, the rows wake:list answers ([{tool, id, on, switched_on, mark}]). Returns one row per cause: what it waits for in plain words (a due time as its schedule), its state (on, running, off, last run failed, outcome unknown, came with no budget left, not picked up yet), red when it needs the person, why (a failed run says its cause), its last run and outcome, and the switch that turns it off or on; red rows first, then switched-on ones, with counts of red, on and off.
